context_requirements: Expression of GABA transaminase (ABAT) and an active GABA shunt
Presence of GABA or GABA-mimetic substrate to inhibit
Neuronal or hepatic metabolic context for a measurable transcriptional consequence
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of GABA-shunt or neurotransmitter-metabolism gene signatures after treatment
Consistent transcriptomic similarity to known GABA transaminase inhibitors across cell lines
